name: fast-ios-device-test
description: Fast iOS verification for Claude Code: /fastSimulatorTest drives Simulator UI flows (with per-simulator fan-out, system and prebuilt apps), /fastDeviceTest runs the same flows on a physical iPhone and records its screen, both with taps, holds, drags, edge swipes, keys, pinch and more; fastUIMap prints the screen map earlier runs recorded; /fastUIReview reviews recorded runs, fastEvidenceSheet builds a captioned PR evidence sheet.
